description: Frontend year-end triggers: (a) EmployeeObserver auto-accrues balance on employee creation, (b) bulk action on the employees list table, (c) dedicated YearEndRolloverPage Filament page. Depends on FEAT-001 (LeaveBalanceService patches and the Artisan command must exist first).
steps: Step 1 — Create app/Observers/EmployeeObserver.php. Namespace App\Observers. No interface to implement. Single method: public function created(Employee $employee): void { try { $service = app(App\Services\LeaveBalanceService::class); $service->accrueAnnual($employee, now()->year); } catch (\Throwable $e) { Log::warning('EmployeeObserver: failed to accrue annual balance for employee '.$employee->id.': '.$e->getMessage()); } } Imports: App\Models\Employee, App\Services\LeaveBalanceService, Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log.

Step 2 — Register EmployeeObserver in app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php. Add import at top: use App\Observers\EmployeeObserver; In boot() method, after the existing LeaveBalance::observe(LeaveBalanceObserver::class); line, add: Employee::observe(EmployeeObserver::class); The Employee model is already imported at the top of AppServiceProvider.

Step 3 — Add bulk action to app/Filament/Resources/EmployeeResource.php. In the table() method, add ->bulkActions([Tables\Actions\BulkAction::make('renewBalances')->label('تجديد الأرصدة السنوية')->icon('heroicon-o-arrow-path')->color('warning')->requiresConfirmation()->action(function (\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection $records): void { $service = app(App\Services\LeaveBalanceService::class); $year = now()->year; $count = 0; foreach ($records as $emp) { try { DB::transaction(function () use ($service, $emp, $year): void { $service->carryOver($emp, $year - 1, $year); $service->accrueAnnual($emp, $year); }); $count++; } catch (\Throwable $e) { \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::warning('BulkRenew failed for employee '.$emp->id.': '.$e->getMessage()); } } Notification::make()->title("تم تجديد الأرصدة لـ {$count} موظف")->success()->send(); }),]) after the ->actions([...]) chain. Add imports at top of EmployeeResource.php: use App\Services\LeaveBalanceService; use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB; use Filament\Notifications\Notification; (check existing imports first — DB and Notification may already be imported).

Step 4 — Create app/Filament/Pages/YearEndRolloverPage.php. Namespace App\Filament\Pages. Extend Filament\Pages\Page, implement HasForms, use InteractsWithForms. Properties: protected static ?string $navigationIcon = 'heroicon-o-arrow-path'; protected static ?string $navigationLabel = 'تجديد الأرصدة السنوية'; protected static ?string $navigationGroup = 'الإعدادات'; protected static string $view = 'filament.pages.year-end-rollover-page'; public ?array $data = []; public string $output = ''; public function mount(): void { $this->form->fill(['year' => now()->year]); } public function form(Form $form): Form — schema: Select::make('year')->label('السنة')->options([now()->year - 1 => now()->year - 1, now()->year => now()->year])->default(now()->year)->required(), Select::make('organization_id')->label('المؤسسة (اختياري)')->options(fn() => \App\Models\Organization::withoutGlobalScopes()->orderBy('name')->pluck('name','id')->toArray())->nullable()->placeholder('الكل'), statePath('data'). public function run(): void { $data = $this->form->getState(); $year = (int) $data['year']; \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan::call('leave:year-end', ['--year' => $year]); $this->output = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan::output(); Notification::make()->title('تم تجديد الأرصدة')->success()->send(); } Imports: Filament\Forms\Components\Select, Filament\Forms\Concerns\InteractsWithForms, Filament\Forms\Contracts\HasForms, Filament\Forms\Form, Filament\Notifications\Notification, Filament\Pages\Page, Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan.

Step 5 — Create resources/views/filament/pages/year-end-rollover-page.blade.php. Follow the pattern of change-password-page.blade.php exactly:
{{$this->form}}
تشغيل التجديد
@if($this->output) 
{{ $this->output }}
@endif
acceptance_criteria: php artisan test passes with no regressions after adding the observer
Employees list table shows 'تجديد الأرصدة السنوية' in bulk actions dropdown when rows are selected
Navigating to /admin/year-end-rollover (or the Filament-generated slug) shows the form with year selector and run button
Submitting the form displays the Artisan command output on the same page
